blurb: High Desert Station offers diverse venues including a rustic barn, elegant ballroom, and scenic outdoor settings for weddings and events. They provide comprehensive event planning services including design, coordination, catering, and photography. The site also features an equestrian center with facilities for roping, rodeos, barrel racing, and equine events, plus RV and trailer parking.
